_comment: Corpus-wide Arabic-name -> established English exonym table. Used by scripts/podcast/knowledge/term_render.py tier 2. Keys are matched via pronunciation_ledger.normalize_key (lowercased, hamza/ayn folded), so write them in plain readable form. Only HIGH-CONFIDENCE, universally recognised exonyms belong here; a name with no standard English form (al-Tabari, Ja'far, Masyaf) is omitted and falls through to plain transliteration. Trim an entry to KEEP the Arabic form for a given register.
